message: Function missing explicit return type annotation

evaluator_config.message_template: Function '{name}' missing explicit return type annotation

rationale: Explicit return types are contracts. They tell the caller what to expect and enable static analysis to catch type mismatches.
remediation: Add return type annotation: def foo() -> Result[int]:

guidance.explanation: The correct version has an explicit return type annotation (-> Result[int]). The incorrect version omits it, preventing static analysis from catching type errors.
